title: Compare labels show the file path instead of the history entry name
description: In-viewer compare (MpiCanvasViewer _labelOf) labels each side name||displayName||file basename, never the history list's operation fallback, and never decodes a project-file?path= URL. An imported entry (no displayName, filePath is a project-file URL) shows the raw encoded URL. Fix: labels follow the history list rule (displayName||operation), same in MpiCompareView.
